page4_rows: A. Project prioritization
Portfolio spread across run, change and regulatory spend
Categorize every project and investment by growth cycle and strategic linkage
Tech Performance Assessment
Pause or stop projects with no clear line to business impact
B. Value capture
ROI, expense-to-revenue ratio, budgeted versus actual investment
Deep dive the five largest investments, tracking committed outcomes against actuals
Tech Performance Assessment
Reset funding on the largest programs and tighten expense management
C. Engineering practices
Developer Velocity Index, time split between inner loop and outer loop
Survey developers across business units, benchmark, then interview engineering leads on root causes
Developer Velocity Index
Free developer capacity by automating environment setup and protecting focus time
D. Performance optimization
Average contribution compared to expectation, anonymized
Analyze Jira and Git repository data to compare contribution against team median
ACCE contribution analytics (Jira and Git data)
Lift bottom-quartile contribution toward the team median
E. Software delivery outcomes
DORA metrics: deploy frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to recover
Collect existing team and org dashboards and compare against benchmarks
DORA benchmarks via existing dashboards
Cut defect rates through testing maturity and automated test coverage
page5_rows: F. Org structure
Role ratios such as PM to developer, pyramid shape, spans and layers
Measure ratios by business unit and squad, compare against best in class
Operating Model Index; Tech Performance FTE baseline
Optimize spans of control and rebalance squad composition
G. Location mix
Onshore versus offshore mix, share of co-located teams
Assess the spread of squads across geographies against industry benchmarks
Tech Performance Assessment (location benchmarks)
Shift the mix toward lower-cost locations and improve co-location
H. FinOps
Cost of unused cloud resources, cloud cost per application, auto-scaling behavior
Review roughly 40 cloud financial management levers across consumption, sourcing and policy
Tech Performance Assessment (cloud cost benchmarks)
Remove double hosting and rationalize on-premise and cloud redundancy
I. Supplier management
Vendor consolidation potential and right-sizing against specifications
Line-by-line review of major contracts covering terms, licenses and rates
Sourcing deep dive (contract teardowns)
Renegotiate and consolidate vendors, stop paying for unused capacity
J. Demand policies
Software and hardware entitlement policies by team
Review spend against policy to find over-provisioned entitlements
Tech Performance Assessment (entitlement benchmarks)
Reduce license counts and extend hardware refresh timelines
K. Process streamlining
Share of build pipeline automated, test coverage, AI generated code
Review the idea-to-live process end to end and identify automation and AI use cases
Tech and AI Quotient; AI process workflow tool
Automate the release pipeline and cut coding time with AI tooling
